Electrical And Electronic Equipment Assemblers install components on circuit boards, wiring harnesses, and finished equipment in electronics factories. paragraphs: Before a shift, assemblers check drawings and materials. They mount and solder components step by step from process cards, then inspect and test at set intervals. Cold joints receive immediate rework. Product changes require workstation and alignment adjustments. At the end of the shift, workers clean stations, save data, and hand off abnormal batches.
